items.evidence: All volumes (5, 4, 1 µL) go through the p20 within its range, the distribute stays under 20 µL per aspirate, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulator ran with all safety checks passing.

The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks passed. Each primer and each colony template gets a fresh tip, and one tip is reused only for master mix into empty wells.

The 10 µL reaction (5 µL Q5 2x, 4 µL primer pair, 1 µL template) adapts the paper's 9 µL mix plus 1 µL colony template to the Q5 and separate-primer reagents. Mix goes in before template, the adaptations are explained in comments, and the cycling is Q5-appropriate.
Each well gets 5 µL 2x master mix (1x in 10 µL) first, then 4 µL of its primer pair, then 1 µL colony template.
colony_wells, primer_wells and pcr_wells are all the first 96 wells in plate order and are zipped together, so A1 maps to A1 and so on, with no well skipped or reused.
A comment records sealing the plate and the program: 98 °C 3 min, 35 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 62 °C 20 s and 72 °C 45 s, then 72 °C 2 min and a 4 °C hold.

judge.summary: The protocol sets up 96 10 µL Q5 colony PCRs, with master mix added first, then a fresh-tip primer pair, then a fresh-tip 1 µL template, all mapped well to well. The pcr_plate end_state failure only reflects the 10 µL versus 20 µL reaction volume, which the rubric allows, so I scored every item 1.

not_applicable: end_state:pcr_plate (the source paper does not determine the exact volumes; composition checked instead)
